sloka: यस्य धर्मे मनो भूयादधर्मम् स निषेवताम् ।अपात्रवर्षी भवतु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४२॥
transliteration: yasya dharme mano bhūyādadharmam sa niṣevatām ।apātravarṣī bhavatu yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-42॥

translations.english: May the mind of that man who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother not be established in virtue May he practise unrighteousness and confer charity on the unworthy
